title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman
blurb: Two systems of thinking, and the predictable biases that show up when the fast one makes decisions the slow one should have checked.
zh: 思考快与慢 认知偏差 决策

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
blurb: Small, repeatable changes to your environment and routine matter more than motivation when you want a habit to stick.
zh: 原子习惯 习惯 自律

title: The Psychology of Money
author: Morgan Housel
blurb: Short essays on why behavior beats intelligence in investing: compounding only works if you never interrupt it, and room for error is what lets you stay in.
zh: 金钱心理学 复利 长期 不打断 风险 投资行为

title: Meditations
author: Marcus Aurelius
blurb: A Roman emperor's private notes to himself on duty, attention and what is within your control.
zh: 沉思录 斯多葛 人生

title: Deep Work
author: Cal Newport
blurb: Why long, undistracted blocks of focus are rare and valuable, and how to protect them from email and chat.
zh: 深度工作 专注 时间管理

title: Poor Charlie's Almanack (穷查理宝典)
author: Charlie Munger, ed. Peter Kaufman
blurb: Munger's talks on a latticework of mental models, inversion, incentives and patient long-term investing.
zh: 穷查理宝典 芒格 复利 长期投资 思维模型 激励 逆向思考

title: The Little Book of Common Sense Investing
author: John C. Bogle
blurb: The case for low-cost index funds: costs compound against you, and most active managers do not beat the market after fees.
zh: 指数基金 费率 定投 长期持有 低成本

title: High Output Management
author: Andrew S. Grove
blurb: A manager's output is the output of their team. Grove covers leverage, one-on-ones, and pairing every indicator with a counter-indicator.
zh: 格鲁夫 管理 领导力 指标

title: Make It Stick
author: Peter C. Brown, Henry L. Roediger III, Mark A. McDaniel
blurb: The research behind retrieval practice and spacing, and why rereading creates a feeling of familiarity without real recall.
zh: 认知天性 学习 记忆 间隔重复 复习

title: Working Backwards
author: Colin Bryar, Bill Carr
blurb: How Amazon starts from a press release and FAQ, writes narratives instead of slides, and organizes around single-threaded leaders.
zh: 逆向工作法 亚马逊 产品 写作

title: Inspired
author: Marty Cagan
blurb: How strong product teams run discovery: test value, usability and feasibility before building, and measure outcomes over output.
zh: 启示录 产品经理 产品发现

title: AI Engineering
author: Chip Huyen
blurb: Building applications on foundation models: evaluation, prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and when to fine-tune.
zh: 人工智能 大模型 评估 检索增强

title: How to Take Smart Notes
author: Sönke Ahrens
blurb: The slip-box method: write notes in your own words and link them, so reading turns into ideas you can reuse.
zh: 卡片笔记写作法 笔记 学习 写作

title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
author: Martin Kleppmann
blurb: The trade-offs behind storage, replication, partitioning and stream processing, explained from first principles.
zh: 数据密集型应用 数据库 系统设计

title: Cracking the PM Interview
author: Gayle Laakmann McDowell, Jackie Bavaro
blurb: Preparing for product manager interviews: product-sense and design questions, estimation, and telling behavioral stories well.
zh: 产品经理面试 面试 求职

title: The Mythical Man-Month
author: Frederick P. Brooks Jr.
blurb: Adding people to a late software project makes it later, because communication overhead grows faster than headcount.
zh: 人月神话 团队 协作 沟通成本

title: Trustworthy Online Controlled Experiments
author: Ron Kohavi, Diane Tang, Ya Xu
blurb: Running A/B tests at scale: choosing an overall evaluation criterion, guardrail metrics, variance reduction, and the pitfalls that fool teams.
zh: 实验 A/B测试 指标 度量

title: Tao Te Ching (道德经)
author: Laozi
blurb: Short verses on simplicity, restraint and acting without forcing.
zh: 道德经 老子 无为 哲学

title: The Art of War
author: Sun Tzu
blurb: Classic Chinese treatise on strategy: know yourself and your opponent, and win before the battle starts.
zh: 孙子兵法 战略 知己知彼

title: Auction Theory
author: Vijay Krishna
blurb: A rigorous treatment of first-price and second-price auctions, bidding strategy, revenue equivalence, and how reserve prices change seller revenue.
zh: 拍卖理论 竞价 定价 博弈论

title: Building a Second Brain
author: Tiago Forte
blurb: A system for capturing, organizing and regularly reviewing what you save, so notes turn into finished work.
zh: 打造第二大脑 笔记 复盘

title: Radical Candor
author: Kim Scott
blurb: Caring personally while challenging directly: how managers give feedback that is heard instead of avoided.
zh: 绝对坦率 反馈 领导力
